The high-energy admixture of the reset state is sin(theta_j); an exact uniform-in-time wavefunction difference yields the explicit trace-distance bound after resetting. The Horodecki singular-value identity then yields the uniform Bell error. The unique maximum of k/(1+k²), a gap-away compactness argument and endpoint controls prove the sharp supremum and location of all maximizers. The fixed-j weak-reset formula is a separate energy-dephasing calculation. The packaged independent spectral-vs-Liouville script passes 262 assertions; the theorem does not rest on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The Bell-CHSH threshold distinguishes genuine two-party nonlocality from the concurrence considered in the motivating paper. A uniform-in-rate asymptotic bound yields the exact operational strong-coupling ceiling sqrt(5) and forces every optimal stochastic reset rate to an emergent second-order energy splitting Omega²/(2J). The fixed-interaction weak-reset limit is Bell-local, exposing a singular tuning law useful for experimental reset-rate design. The statement is a structural quantitative theorem, not merely a restatement of the known concurrence maximum.
